text_blocks.snippet: A COVID-19 lockdown refers to a temporary period of strict restrictions imposed by governments to slow the spread of the COVID-19 virus. These restrictions typically include:

list.title: Stay-at-home orders:
list.snippet: People are required to remain at home as much as possible, except for essential activities such as grocery shopping, medical appointments, or work.

list.title: Closure of non-essential businesses:
list.snippet: Schools, restaurants, bars, theaters, and other non-essential businesses are closed to the public.

list.title: Cancellation of events:
list.snippet: Mass gatherings, such as concerts, sporting events, and conferences, are canceled or postponed.
